decisive_items: He had undergone chemoradiotherapy 15 years earlier for squamous cell carcinoma of the left buccal mucosa
spindle cells were positive for vimentin, α-smooth muscle actin, p63, p53, and CD68
response.rationale: The prior squamous carcinoma, polypoid mucosal lesion, and spindle cells with p63/vimentin/α-SMA positivity despite negative pan-keratin are characteristic of sarcomatoid carcinoma. Bone destruction and CD68 are secondary, and no osteoid or low-grade inflammatory pattern supports the alternatives.

rejected.why: Bone destruction is present but no osteoid or osteoblastic features; IHC p63/CD68/α-SMA is not consistent with osteosarcoma.
Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor is contradicted by bizarre nuclei, atypical mitoses, Ki-67 50%, bone destruction, and p63 positivity.
CD68 and spindle cells are present, but p63 and α-SMA positivity plus the mucosal polyp with overlying squamous epithelium favor sarcomatoid carcinoma over malignant fibrous histiocytoma.
